prompts.caption: Instrumental Chinese melodic EDM with adventurous and uplifting energy. A concise minor-pentatonic pipa hook is answered by airy dizi phrases and doubled by bright synth plucks. The arrangement builds gradually into a clear four-on-the-floor drop with wide synth chords, clean sub bass, crisp electronic drums and spacious fantasy ambience.

Instrumental melodic gaming progressive house with an optimistic and energetic mood. A short rising synth motif develops through varied endings and call-and-response phrases over clear chord movement. An atmospheric intro adds layers gradually before a bright four-on-the-floor drop with crisp drums, controlled sub bass, wide chords and a denser final return.

Instrumental cinematic glitch-hop with playful suspense and a clear syncopated lead motif. Short glitched-synth phrases trade with restrained orchestral accents over punchy halftime drums and controlled sub bass. A sparse contrasting break interrupts the main groove before the motif returns with stronger layering, sharper micro-edits and wide cinematic space.
